name: Pardons
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s pardons are a profound expression of His mercy and forgiveness toward sinners who repent and turn to Him. The Psalms celebrate the blessedness of those whose transgressions are forgiven and sins covered, highlighting God’s gracious healing and forgiveness of all iniquities. Isaiah emphasizes that God abundantly pardons the unrighteous who forsake their sinful ways, while Jeremiah assures believers that God will forgive their iniquities and remember their sins no more. Daniel affirms that mercies and forgiveness belong to the Lord, even when His people have rebelled against Him, underscoring the steadfastness of God’s pardoning love.
